breakdown.description: The prompt describes a 2D dam break case but configures the front and back boundaries as 'wall' with 'noSlip', which imposes a viscous boundary layer and makes the flow inherently three-dimensional, violating the 2D assumption.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Define the frontAndBack patches as type wall, applying a noSlip condition for velocity and zeroGradient for scalar fields.' This directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires frontAndBack patches to be 'type empty' with 'empty' boundary conditions on all fields to enforce a proper 2D simulation. The agent failed to identify and correct this inconsistency.
